title.a: 就這樣沉浸在祢的愛中

tags: 大衛帳幕的榮耀 11 溫柔聖靈
meta.author:
約書亞樂團
詞、曲：張全佑、謝思穎、璽恩、曾晨恩

lines.a: 我在遠處望向 家的門口
lines.b: Here I am far away, longing for home

lines.a: 祢在路的盡頭 等待著我
lines.b: There you stand at the gate waiting for me

lines.a: 蹣跚狼狽的我 祢親吻我
lines.b: Desolate, yet I am met by Your kiss

lines.a: 被祢掛念的我 不再失落
lines.b: I’m no longer at loss, here in Your heart

lines.a: 祢接納我 回祢家中
lines.b: You pull me close, bring me back home
There is no love like Yours

lines.a: 祢擁抱我 在祢懷中
lines.b: You hold me close in Your embrace

lines.a: 我想就這樣 沉浸在祢的愛中
lines.b: I just want to stay soaking deep within Your love

lines.a: 我想就這樣 沉浸在祢的愛中
lines.b: I just want to stay soaking deep within Your love

lines.a: 我想就這樣 沉浸在祢的愛中
lines.b: I just want to stay soaking deep within Your love

lines.a: 我想就這樣 沉浸在祢的懷中
lines.b: I just want to stay resting here in Your embrace
